import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

Registered. Now finishing the turn through the SASE final declaration.

I've published the lead's report as `202611/bank_daily_acknowledgment/bank_daily_acknowledgment.md` and registered it as `file:explicit:2e24cda5335e947a0ef32522`. It gets committed to the research repo after this turn ends.

**Diagrams:** none were placed. The image agent's diagrams status was `none`: it considered 17 candidates and declined each because existing tables, lists or the lead's own Figures 1 and 2 already cover them. With no manifest, there are no figure anchors and no omitted diagram IDs to report.

**Opening:** the file opens with the lead's title, then a two-sentence research query, then the infographic, then `## Bottom line`.

**Layout:** sections now follow the order a reader would ask:
- Bottom line
- Is this a good idea
- What the evidence says
- Requirement adjustments
- The design, with its subsections
- Alternatives considered
- Where the researchers disagreed and how I resolved it
- Corrections to the individual reports
- Phasing
- Open questions
- Recommended solution, last as you asked
- Sources

The lead's italic inputs note ("five independent reports…", "All amounts in the examples are made up") now opens the evidence section.

**Edits beyond moving sections:**
- **Headings:** five headings lost the punctuation or code that would break links. Most kept their words. Two were reworded:
  - `Proving "every": the balance check` became "Proving every transaction with the balance check".
  - `Views: the beautiful part` became "Views that make it beautiful".
- **Moved qualifier:** "(after `bob-cli-k3`)" moved out of the subscriptions heading into that section's first line.
- **Links:** I added 17 in-document links. Three `(next section)`/`(see below)` pointers became real links, because moving sections had made them point to the wrong place.

**Checks:**
- Every line that differs from the lead's text is one of those intended edits.
- All table rows and cells, all 12 code blocks (including both Mermaid figures) and all 18 external URLs carried over.
- Every in-document link matches a heading ID in pandoc's output.

**Links:** 17 of the 18 URLs returned a working response. The openbankingtracker.com Wells Fargo page returned 429 twice, so it is unverified and kept. No link was dead.
